module.coursesBody: Learn at your own pace, no internet
module.assistantBody: Local AI that reads your library

getStarted.title: Set up your Nomad
getStarted.body: Choose the knowledge you want to carry with you. We'll suggest a starter pack based on your free space.

onboarding.welcomeTitle: Knowledge that stays with you offline
onboarding.welcomeBody: Wikipedia, medical and survival guides, maps, courses and a local AI. Download once, use it wherever there's no signal.
onboarding.packBody: You can always add or remove content from the Library.

light.name: Light
light.body: The essentials: compact Wikipedia, first aid and basic survival.

balanced.name: Balanced
balanced.body: Wikipedia without images plus the essential tier of every collection.

complete.name: Complete
complete.body: Full compact Wikipedia plus the standard tier of every collection.

none.name: I'll choose
none.body: Start empty and browse the catalog at your own pace.

onboarding.tooBig: Doesn't fit in your free space
onboarding.readyBodyDownloads: We've started downloading {{count}} resources ({{size}}). You can keep using the app meanwhile.
onboarding.readyBodyEmpty: Browse the Library, download the map of your area and try the assistant.
onboarding.tipWifi: Large downloads work best on Wi‑Fi with your phone charging.
onboarding.tipMaps: In Maps you can download your country or whatever area is on screen.
onboarding.tipAi: In Assistant you can download an AI model that works without internet.

emergency.title: Emergency
emergency.body: Hospitals, police, water and shelters near you, offline
